name: Logitech G502 HERO
description: The Logitech G502 HERO is a high-performance gaming mouse equipped with the HERO 25K sensor, delivering exceptional precision and speed. It features customizable RGB lighting, adjustable weights, and 11 programmable buttons designed for gamers who want maximum control and performance in every session.

comments.comment: Perfect grip and smooth tracking, worth every penny!
Software customization is very easy to use.
Definitely the best mouse I’ve owned for gaming.

name: Razer DeathAdder V2
description: The Razer DeathAdder V2 is designed with an ergonomic shape that fits perfectly into the hand, ensuring long hours of comfortable gaming. Featuring Razer’s Focus+ Optical Sensor with 20,000 DPI, this mouse delivers incredible accuracy, speed, and responsiveness, making it a trusted choice for esports professionals.

comments.comment: Very accurate sensor, I love how responsive it is.
Good for long gaming sessions, but slightly pricey.
The ergonomic design really helps reduce wrist pain.

name: Corsair Harpoon RGB Wireless
description: Corsair Harpoon RGB Wireless offers a lightweight design with sub-1ms Slipstream wireless technology. It features 10,000 DPI optical sensor, six fully programmable buttons, and RGB lighting for gamers who want performance without wires.

comments.comment: Wireless works flawlessly, no noticeable delay.
Battery life is impressive, lasts over a week.
Lightweight and responsive, very happy with it.

name: SteelSeries Rival 600
description: The SteelSeries Rival 600 introduces dual-sensor technology for true depth perception and accurate lift-off detection. It comes with customizable weight tuning and split-trigger buttons, giving gamers high precision and a premium feel.

comments.comment: The dual sensor makes it incredibly accurate.
Great build quality, feels very durable.
Expensive but worth it for the performance.

name: Glorious Model O
description: The Glorious Model O is an ultra-lightweight gaming mouse with a honeycomb shell design. It provides smooth glide with G-Skates feet and features RGB lighting along with a high precision sensor, making it a favorite among competitive gamers.

comments.comment: So light you barely feel it in your hand!
Cable is flexible and doesn’t drag at all.

name: Microsoft Bluetooth Mouse
description: The Microsoft Bluetooth Mouse is a simple and reliable option for everyday productivity. With wireless connectivity, compact design, and efficient battery life, this mouse is ideal for office use and casual computing tasks.

comments.comment: Good for daily office work, nothing fancy.
Affordable and works well with laptops.

name: Apple Magic Mouse 2
description: Apple Magic Mouse 2 features a multi-touch surface that allows gestures like swiping between web pages and scrolling through documents. Its sleek, rechargeable design makes it lightweight and stylish, perfect for Mac users.

comments.comment: Looks beautiful on my desk, very smooth surface.
Rechargeable battery is a great addition.

name: HP X200 Wireless Mouse
description: The HP X200 Wireless Mouse offers a reliable 2.4GHz connection with a comfortable, ambidextrous design. It’s lightweight, portable, and comes with a long-lasting battery, making it a practical solution for students and professionals alike.

comments.comment: Simple but effective for everyday work.

name: Cooler Master MM710
description: The Cooler Master MM710 is an ultralight gaming mouse with a honeycomb shell that reduces weight without sacrificing durability. It comes with an ultraweave cable to minimize drag and a PixArt 16000 DPI sensor for accurate tracking.

comments.comment: Super light and comfortable for gaming.
Design could be better but performance is solid.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S
description: The Logitech MX Master 3S is built for productivity, featuring ultra-fast scrolling, ergonomic design, and customizable buttons. With cross-computer control and Bluetooth connectivity, it’s perfect for professionals who multitask across multiple screens.

comments.comment: The scroll wheel is insanely smooth!
Very ergonomic, no hand fatigue at all.

name: Razer Basilisk V3
description: Razer Basilisk V3 is a customizable gaming mouse with a smart scroll wheel, 11 programmable buttons, and Razer Chroma RGB. It features a high-performance sensor with 26,000 DPI, giving precise control for competitive gaming.

comments.comment: The RGB lighting is just stunning!
Super accurate sensor, perfect for FPS.
Best mouse I’ve used so far.

name: Dell WM126 Wireless Mouse
description: Dell WM126 Wireless Mouse offers reliable performance and long battery life in a compact design. It connects easily via USB receiver and is suitable for both left and right-handed users.

comments.comment: Affordable and works well for office use.
Battery life is excellent for the price.

name: Asus ROG Gladius III
description: Asus ROG Gladius III is a high-end gaming mouse with replaceable switches and advanced optical sensor. It features low-latency wired and wireless modes, customizable buttons, and RGB lighting integrated with Aura Sync.

comments.comment: Wireless connection feels smooth and reliable.
A bit expensive but solid performance.

name: Lenovo 530 Wireless Mouse
description: Lenovo 530 Wireless Mouse provides reliable performance with a simple plug-and-play setup. Its slim and portable design makes it suitable for both home and office use, ensuring consistent performance.

comments.comment: Compact and easy to carry around.
Nothing special but does the job.

name: HyperX Pulsefire FPS Pro
description: The HyperX Pulsefire FPS Pro is a gaming mouse equipped with a Pixart 3389 sensor for extreme accuracy. It comes with customizable RGB lighting, six programmable buttons, and onboard memory to save settings directly on the mouse.

comments.comment: Software could be better, but overall great.
